Steps.title:
Get set up
in minutes
Steps.body: Choose the plan that fits how you work. Reserve a desk, office, or room in a few taps. Show up, tap in with your fingerprint, and get to work.
Steps.step1Body: Start with a day pass, or go monthly for 24/7 fingerprint access and 15% off the meeting room. Private offices too, and no long lock-in.
Steps.step2Body: Reserve a desk, a meeting room, or the events hall online. Your fingerprint gives you access whenever you need it.
Steps.step3Body: Walk in, tap in, and focus. Fast Wi-Fi, meeting rooms, coffee, and a community are all included.

items.q: Can I see it before I commit?
items.a: Yes. Book a free tour on WhatsApp during staffed hours, or come in on a day pass. If you decide to join, your day pass counts in full toward your first month.
MAZJ opened recently, and the founding members are shaping what it becomes. Join early as one of the first 15 to help set the tone of the community and keep your founding perks.
The space is staffed Sunday to Thursday, 9am to 9pm. Members with a membership or a private office enter any time, 24/7, using their fingerprint.

items.q: What's included with a desk or office?
items.a: Fast Wi-Fi, free drinks, and the shared areas come with every plan. Members get 15% off the Al-Malqa meeting room, and monthly private offices get 20% off.
Bookings are confirmed and paid on mazj.sa and are non-refundable under the current policy. If your plans change, contact the team before your booking date and we'll do our best to help.
Checkout happens on mazj.sa. You can pay by card, and split payments with Tamara or Tabby where available.

items.q: Can I get a VAT invoice?
items.a: Yes. MAZJ is VAT-registered with tax number 310240548700003, and a tax invoice is issued for your booking on request.
Day passes and memberships cover one person. For meetings with guests, book the Al-Malqa room, or ask the team at reception during staffed hours.
Life Tower is easy to reach by car, and parking is available around the tower. Ask the team for the closest option when you visit.

AboutPage.title:
The blend is
the point
AboutPage.intro: MAZJ (مزج) is a shared workspace in Life Tower, Al-Khobar: desks, offices, rooms, and the community that grows between them.
AboutPage.storyBody: The name means "blend": people doing different work, at different stages, sharing one space and sharpening each other's ideas. We started MAZJ in Al-Khobar because the Eastern Province's founders, freelancers, and teams deserved a place of their own to work well and meet each other.
AboutPage.spaceBody: One address in Life Tower on Zaid Ibn Alkhattab Street, Al-Olaya: open desks in the shared space, private offices, the Al-Malqa meeting room, and the Al-Ma'arij events hall. Staffed Sunday to Thursday from 9am to 9pm, with 24/7 fingerprint entry for members.
AboutPage.communityBody: More than desks: gatherings, events, and programs that connect the people building things in the Eastern Province. Work next to people worth knowing, and let the rest happen on its own.

CommunityPage.title:
People worth
sharing a table with
CommunityPage.intro: MAZJ's community brings the Eastern Province's founders, freelancers, and builders under one roof.
CommunityPage.body: A good workspace gives you a desk; a good community gives you momentum. At MAZJ, the space between desks is where things happen: introductions over coffee, questions answered in passing, and rooms full of people who get things done. Through gatherings, events, and programs, we make those collisions happen on purpose.
